reason: A data-vault plugin for DeepSeek Harness that monitors, backs up, restores, and deletes local chat, workspace, settings, credential, and profile data through a settings page and model tool.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地数据保险箱，可自动备份并检测清空情况，还能通过设置页面或工具恢复聊天记录、工作区及相关配置。
summaries.en: A local data vault for DeepSeek Harness that automatically backs up and detects cleared data, with settings-page and tool-based restoration for chats, workspaces, and related configuration.

capabilities: Automatically backs up chat history, workspace data, settings, credentials, and profile configuration
Reads and writes files outside the application data directory
Restores selected or all backed-up data and may overwrite current files
